supplemental.summary: YD Bio operates in three segments: (1) DNA methylation-based cancer detection technology licensed from EG BioMed (commercial laboratory-developed test for pancreatic cancer; recurrent breast cancer monitoring test in development) - these are LDTs/diagnostics, not therapeutic clinical trials; (2) stem cell and exosome-based ophthalmology therapies via partner 3D Global Biotech (exosome-based contact lenses and artificial tears for dry eye, glaucoma, corneal injury) - trials PLANNED for 2027, not yet initiated; (3) clinical trial support services.
